#=============================

# 1. Fluad, Vaccine

##Functional analysis

### Condition-wise

BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species

#### Immune

##### Mean Log2FC and GSEA (Immune)

Compare means and NES Import

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Influenza", vaccine = "Fluad",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
  rename(mean_l2fc = mean,
         ci_lower = lower,
         ci_upper = upper)

#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "influenza_fluad_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%    
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%  
  add_significance()

dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  left_join(
    pvals_vs_zero %>% 
      select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, p, p_adjust = p.adj),
    by = c("organism", "pathogen", "timepoint", "process")
  ) %>% 
  clean_names()

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))

```



##### GSEA

```{r message=FALSE}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint),
          log2fold_change_logp = log2fold_change * -log(adj_p_val)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, rank = log2fold_change_logp)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_btm_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "BTMs")


gsea_btm_results = gsea_btm_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  full_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_btm_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
```


#### MSigDB Hallmarks

##### Mean Log2FC

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Influenza", vaccine = "Fluad",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% 
   rename(mean_l2fc = mean,
         ci_lower = lower,
         ci_upper = upper)

filename = "influenza_fluad_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

# Import Hallmarks -------

#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_hallmarks_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped, by = "symbol")

dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))

dge_hallmarks_mean_process = dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%     # testa média contra zero
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%      # corrige FDR
  rstatix::add_significance()

dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_hallmarks_mean_process <- dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>%
  left_join(
    pvals_vs_zero %>% 
      select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, p, p_adjust = p.adj),
    by = c("organism", "pathogen", "timepoint", "process")
  ) %>% 
  clean_names()

#Print
dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
```

# 2. Engerix B, Vaccine

### Condition-wise

BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species

#### BTMs

##### Mean Log2FC

Compare means and NES Import

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Hepatitis B", vaccine = "EngerixB",
         timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))

#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct() 

#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc),
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%     # testa média contra zero
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%      # corrige FDR
  add_significance()

dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
```

##### GSEA

```{r}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint),
          log2fold_change_logp = log2fold_change * -log(adj_p_val)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, rank = log2fold_change_logp)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_btm_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "BTMs")


gsea_btm_results = gsea_btm_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  full_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_btm_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
```

#####Plot distributions

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
#Import ========================
gsea_btm_results = readRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
dge_btm_mean_process = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
dge_btm_process_genes = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))


#If timepoints match between ref and target, use this
dge_btm_process_genes_matched = dge_btm_process_genes

#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_btm_results %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(condition, "Human") ~ "Human",
                              T~condition)) %>% 
  select(organism, timepoint, process, group, subgroup, set_size, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust, qvalue) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, process, subgroup, group, set_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust, qvalue, set_size),
    names_sep = "_")

#Arrange process by log2fc
process_order_log2fc = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, organism, mean_log2fc, group) %>%
  filter(timepoint == 7,
         organism == "Human") %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, group) %>% 
  arrange(-mean_log2fc) %>%
  pull(process) %>% 
  unique() 

dge_btm_process_ordered = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(group = fct_relevel(as.factor(group), c(immune_order)),
           process = fct_relevel(as.factor(process), c(process_order_log2fc)) %>% fct_rev()) 

labels_process <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(process, p_adjust_Human, p_adjust_Mouse) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(p_adjust_Human <= 0.10 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.10, 
                         "bold", "plain"),
         label_color = ifelse(p_adjust_Human <= 0.10 & p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.10, 
                         "#4DBBD5FF", "gray50"))  %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(process = fct_relevel(process, process_order_log2fc)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(p_adjust_Human))
  

#Plot
dge_btm_process_distribution = dge_btm_process_genes_matched %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint_num),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = process,
      x = mean_l2fc,
      color = organism) +
  facet_grid(~group~timepoint, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_point(pch = "|", alpha = 1, 
             show.legend = F,
             size = 3) +
  stat_summary(
  aes(color = organism),
  fun.data = mean_se,
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.5,
  size = 1) +
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = organism), 
    fun = mean,             
    color = "black",
    geom = "point",             
    size = 2,    
    pch = 21,  
    alpha = 1,
    show.legend = T 
  ) +
  
  # xlim(-2, 2) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray", alpha = 0.5),
        legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, face = c(labels_process$label), 
                                   color = c(labels_process$label_color)),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(alpha = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha = 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
    labs(color = "Organism",
       y = "",
       x = "Log2FC",
       fill = "Organism",
       title = "Mouse vs Human, BTMs genes, mean Log2FC") 

dge_btm_process_distribution 

dge_btm_process_distribution %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_distribution.png")),
         height = 12, 
         width = 10)


```

Plot distributions

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
#Import ========================
gsea_hallmarks_results = readRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_mean_process = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
dge_hallmarks_process_genes = readRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_process_genes.rds")))
#Get annotated processes
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

#If timepoints match between ref and target, use this
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched = dge_hallmarks_process_genes

gsea_hallmarks_results_matched = gsea_hallmarks_results 

#Pivot to wide GSEA + mean
dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide = gsea_hallmarks_results_matched %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(condition, "Human") ~ "Human",
                              T~condition)) %>% 
  select(organism, timepoint, process, set_size, nes, mean_log2fc, p_adjust, qvalue) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, process,  set_size) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
    values_from = c(mean_log2fc, nes, p_adjust, qvalue, set_size),
    names_sep = "_")

#Arrange process by log2fc
process_order_log2fc = dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  select(process, timepoint, organism, mean_log2fc) %>%
  filter(timepoint == 7,
         organism == "Human") %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(-mean_log2fc) %>%
  pull(process) %>% 
  unique() 

dge_hallmarks_process_ordered = dge_hallmarks_mean_process 
  

#Plot
dge_hallmarks_process_distribution = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched %>% 
    mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint_num),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])))  %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(y = process,
      x = mean_l2fc,
      color = organism) +
  facet_grid(~group~timepoint, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_point(pch = "|", alpha = 1, 
             show.legend = F,
             size = 3) +
  stat_summary(
  aes(color = organism),
  fun.data = mean_se,
  geom = "errorbar",
  width = 0.5,
  size = 1) +
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = organism), 
    fun = mean,             
    color = "black",
    geom = "point",             
    size = 2,    
    pch = 21,  
    alpha = 1,
    show.legend = T 
  ) +
  
  # xlim(-2, 2) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "gray", alpha = 0.5),
        legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(alpha = 0.5),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha = 0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
                               "Human" = "#90A4AEFF")) +
    labs(color = "Organism",
       y = "",
       x = "Log2FC",
       fill = "Organism",
       title = "Mouse vs Human, MSigDB genes, mean Log2FC") 

dge_hallmarks_process_distribution 

dge_hallmarks_process_distribution %>%
```

# 3. S. aureus

## Functional analysis

### Immune

BTMs correlation, intra- and inter-species

#### Mean Log2FC

Compare means and NES Import

```{r}
#Import datasets ------
#Import DGE output
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = "Saureus")
#Import BTMs annotation table
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"

#Clean metadata 
annotation_conditions = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct()

#Get calculate means -----
#Annotate genes by BTM 

dge_btm_process_genes = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  inner_join(btm_annotation_genes, by = "symbol") %>% 
  filter(organism %in% c("Human", "Mouse")) 

dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_process_genes.rds")))

dge_btm_mean_process = dge_btm_process_genes %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  summarise(mean_log2fc = mean(mean_l2fc),
            median_log2fc = median(mean_l2fc), 
            sd_log2fc = sd(mean_l2fc),
            var_log2fc = var(mean_l2fc),
            n_genes = n(),
            organism, pathogen,
            group, subgroup) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%     # testa média contra zero
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%      # corrige FDR
  add_significance()

dge_btm_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_btm_mean_process <- dge_btm_mean_process %>%
  left_join(
    pvals_vs_zero %>% 
      select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, p, p_adjust = p.adj),
    by = c("organism", "pathogen", "timepoint", "process")
  )  

#Print
dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_btm_mean_process.rds")))
```

#### GSEA

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = btm_annotation_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint),
          log2fold_change_logp = log2fold_change * -log(adj_p_val)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, rank = log2fold_change_logp)


#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_btm_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "BTM")


gsea_btm_results = gsea_btm_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  inner_join(dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_btm_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_btm_results.rds")))
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
  mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint)) 

pvals_vs_zero <- dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>%
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>% 
  rstatix::t_test(mean_l2fc ~ 1, mu = 0) %>%     
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%     
  rstatix::add_significance()

dge_hallmarks_process_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  filter(n < 2)

dge_hallmarks_mean_process <- dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>%
  left_join(
    pvals_vs_zero %>% 
      select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, process, p, p_adjust = p.adj),
    by = c("organism", "pathogen", "timepoint", "process")
  ) %>% 
  clean_names()

#Print
dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_dge_hallmarks_mean_process.rds")))
```

#### GSEA

```{r message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
#Run GSEA for DGE outputs-----
#Human ImmuneGO/BTMs
term2gene = msigdbr_grouped  %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Clean table for GSEA standard
df_genes2GSEA <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen, timepoint, 
         genes = human_symbol, log2fold_change = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genes), !is.na(log2fold_change)) %>%
   mutate(condition = paste0(organism,"_", pathogen, "_", timepoint),
          log2fold_change_logp = log2fold_change * -log(adj_p_val)) %>% 
  select(condition, genes, rank = log2fold_change_logp)

#Run multiple GSEA and unite means
gsea_hallmarks_output = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "MSigDB Hallmarks")


gsea_hallmarks_results = gsea_hallmarks_output$gsea %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  rename(process = id) %>%
  #Unite means and GSEA
  full_join(dge_hallmarks_mean_process %>% 
              rename(p_adjust_mean = p_adjust), by = join_by("condition", "process"))
  
  
#Save
gsea_hallmarks_results %>% 
    saveRDS(here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gsea_hallmarks_results.rds")))
```

### Volcano plot
```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

#Volcano plot -------
volcano_data <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  mutate(logp = -log10(adj_p_val),
         sig = case_when(mean_l2fc > 0 & logp > 1.3 ~ "Up",
                         mean_l2fc < 0 & logp > 1.3 ~ "Down",
                         TRUE ~ "NS"))

volcano_plot = volcano_data %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_l2fc, y = logp, fill = sig) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~pathogen+timepoint+organism, 
               scales = "free", 
               axes = "all",
               nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "black")) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig,
                 color = sig),
             pch = 21, 
             size = 1, 
             alpha = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = 1, size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.3, color = "black", linetype = 2, size = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 5,
                     # limits = c(0, 70),
                     expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  guides(color = F) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Up" = "#165289", 
      "Down" = "#45efc6",
      "NS" = "gray80")) +
  labs(x = "Log2-Fold Change",
       y = "-log(FDR)",
       fill = "Direction") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))  +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)),
         color = "none")

volcano_plot

#Save
volcano_plot %>% 
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "all_human_mouse_qc_volcano_plot_raw.png"),
         width = 16,
         height = 16)


```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
#Get total genes by each condition
degs_mouse = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Mouse")
degs_human = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human")

degs_mouse_summarize = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  group_by(organism, pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n()) 

#Print
degs_mouse_summarize

#Get overlap -----
#Get symbols
degs_mouse_genes = degs_mouse %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint_comparison, pathogen) %>% 
  distinct()

degs_human_genes = degs_human %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint_comparison, pathogen) %>% 
  distinct()

#Inner join, Mouse and Human ------

#Mouse
degs_human_and_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  inner_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint_comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse AND Human",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         group = "Common")

#Duplicate rows for human
degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human = degs_human_and_mouse_genes %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")


#Anti join, Human vs Mouse -------
#Human
#Human vs Mouse
degs_human_Not_mouse_genes = degs_human_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_mouse_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint_comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Human NOT Mouse", 
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         organism = "Human",
         group = "Not common")

#Models
#Mouse vs Human
degs_mouse_Not_human_genes = degs_mouse_genes %>% 
  anti_join(degs_human_genes, 
             by = join_by("pathogen", "human_symbol", "timepoint_comparison")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = "Mouse NOT Human",
         organism = "Mouse",
         comparison = "Mouse vs Human",
         group = "Not common")


#Merge data ------
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes = 
  bind_rows(degs_human_and_mouse_genes,
            degs_human_and_mouse_genes_human,
            degs_human_Not_mouse_genes,
            degs_mouse_Not_human_genes 
            )

#Classify by same and exclusive DEGs -----
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, condition, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  summarise(n = n(),
            organism,
            comparison,
            group) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  separate(timepoint_comparison, into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human"), sep = "-", remove = F) %>% 
  filter(!c(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" & timepoint_mouse == "24h"))
  

ranges_y = degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  summarise(limit_max = max(n))

degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary
ranges_y
```

```{r}
#Pivot wider
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, timepoint_comparison, mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, p_adj = adj_p_val, tstatistic = t) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c("organism"),
              values_from = c(mean_log2fc, p_adj, tstatistic),
              names_sep = "_",
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_human, mean_log2fc_mouse)

human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide

# Calculate the correlation
#Get immune and non immune genes
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune = 
  
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  mutate(gene_type = "All genes") %>% 
  
  bind_rows(
  #Same DEGs
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = "DEGs"), 
  #Classify as immune or non_immune 
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
  mutate(gene_type = if_else(human_symbol %in% c(btm_annotation_genes %>%
                               filter(module_category == "immune") %>% 
                               pull(symbol)),
                             "Immune",
                             "Not-immune")) %>% 
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05)) 
  
   

#Summary
degs_immune_nonimmune_summary = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_immune_nonimmune %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison, gene_type) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison, gene_type) %>%
  summarise(
    cor_test_spearman = list(safe_cor_test(mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human, method = "spearman")),
    cor_test_pearson = list(safe_cor_test(mean_log2fc_mouse, mean_log2fc_human, method = "pearson")),,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(degs_immune_nonimmune_summary, by = join_by("pathogen", "timepoint_comparison", "gene_type")) %>% 
  mutate(
    #Spearman
    cor_value_spearman = map_dbl(cor_test_spearman, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$estimate),
    p_spearman   = map_dbl(cor_test_spearman, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$p.value),
    p_label_spearman = case_when(
      is.na(p_spearman)      ~ "ns",
      p_spearman <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_spearman <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_spearman <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label_spearman = paste0("rho=", round(cor_value_spearman, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_label_spearman),
    #Pearson
    cor_value_pearson = map_dbl(cor_test_pearson, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$estimate),
    p_pearson   = map_dbl(cor_test_pearson, ~ if (is.null(.x)) NA_real_ else .x$p.value),
    p_label_pearson = case_when(
      is.na(p_pearson)      ~ "ns",
      p_pearson <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_pearson <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_pearson <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label_pearson = paste0("r=", round(cor_value_pearson, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_label_pearson)
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(cor_value_spearman,
          cor_value_pearson) %>% 
  mutate(
    gene_type = factor(gene_type, levels = c("All genes", "DEGs", "Not-immune", "Immune")),
    facet_label = paste0(gene_type, ": ", label_spearman)) %>% 
    #Reorder timepoints
  separate(timepoint_comparison, into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human"), remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7"))) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_mouse) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_comparison = fct_inorder(timepoint_comparison))
```

### Correlation: RRHO of means

```{r}
# 1. Identify all unique pathogen and timepoint combinations
combinations <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  distinct(pathogen, timepoint_comparison)

# 2. Initialize a list to store results from each iteration
all_rrho_results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(combinations)) {
  
  curr_pathogen <- combinations$pathogen[i]
  curr_timepoint <- combinations$timepoint_comparison[i]
  
  # A. Filter and Prepare Differential Expression (DDE) Scores
  rrho_input_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
    filter(pathogen == curr_pathogen, timepoint_comparison == curr_timepoint) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_adj_human), !is.na(p_adj_mouse), 
           !is.na(mean_log2fc_human), !is.na(mean_log2fc_mouse)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Handle p-values of 0 to avoid infinite logs
      p_adj_human = ifelse(p_adj_human == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_human),
      p_adj_mouse = ifelse(p_adj_mouse == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_mouse),
      # Calculate DDE score: -log10(p-value) * sign of Fold Change
      score_human = -log10(p_adj_human) * sign(mean_log2fc_human),
      score_mouse = -log10(p_adj_mouse) * sign(mean_log2fc_mouse)
    )

  # Skip if the gene list is too small (RRHO2 requires a minimum set)
  if(nrow(rrho_input_data) < 100) next 

  # B. Prepare Sorted Gene Lists for RRHO2
  # Sorting from highest to lowest DDE score is mandatory for RRHO analysis
  gene_list1 <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_human)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_human) %>% 
    as.data.frame()
    
  gene_list2 <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_mouse)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_mouse) %>% 
    as.data.frame()

  # Identify the Biological Split Point (where DDE score crosses zero)
  # This marks the boundary between Up-regulated and Down-regulated genes
  split_h_val <- sum(gene_list1$DDE > 0)
  split_m_val <- sum(gene_list2$DDE > 0)

  # C. Execute RRHO2
  # Using 'try' to skip iterations that might encounter mathematical errors
  rrho_obj <- try(RRHO2_initialize(gene_list2, gene_list1, 
                                   labels = c("Mouse", "Human"), 
                                   boundary = 0.01,
                                   log10.ind = TRUE, 
                                   method = "hyper"), silent = TRUE)
  
  if(inherits(rrho_obj, "try-error")) next

  # Transform the hypermat (matrix) into a long format dataframe for ggplot2
  temp_df <- as.data.frame(rrho_obj$hypermat) %>%
    mutate(Mouse_Rank = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Mouse_Rank, names_to = "Human_Rank", values_to = "LogP") %>%
    mutate(
      Human_Rank = as.numeric(gsub("V", "", Human_Rank)),
      pathogen = curr_pathogen,       
      timepoint = curr_timepoint,
      # Store the split points to draw exact quadrant boundaries later
      split_h = split_h_val,
      split_m = split_m_val
    )

  all_rrho_results[[i]] <- temp_df
}

# Combine all results into a single final dataframe
final_rrho_df <- bind_rows(all_rrho_results)

# Save the processed data for visualization
final_rrho_df %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_rrho_df.rds"))
 

```

Extract RRHO2 results and gene lists by quadrant
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RRHO2) # Ensure the library is loaded

# 1. Identify all unique pathogen and timepoint combinations
combinations <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  distinct(pathogen, timepoint_comparison)

# 2. Initialize lists to store results
plot_data_list <- list()
gene_extraction_list <- list() # New list for the extracted genes
raw_objects_list <- list()

# --- MAIN LOOP ---
for(i in 1:nrow(combinations)) {
  
  curr_pathogen <- combinations$pathogen[i]
  curr_timepoint <- combinations$timepoint_comparison[i]
  # Create a unique name for each comparison
  iter_name <- paste(curr_pathogen, curr_timepoint, sep = "_")
  
  # --- A. Prepare Data ---
  rrho_input_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
    filter(pathogen == curr_pathogen, timepoint_comparison == curr_timepoint) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_adj_human), !is.na(p_adj_mouse), 
           !is.na(mean_log2fc_human), !is.na(mean_log2fc_mouse)) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_human = ifelse(p_adj_human == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_human),
      p_adj_mouse = ifelse(p_adj_mouse == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_mouse),
      score_human = -log10(p_adj_human) * sign(mean_log2fc_human),
      score_mouse = -log10(p_adj_mouse) * sign(mean_log2fc_mouse)
    )

  if(nrow(rrho_input_data) < 100) next 

  gene_list_human <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_human)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_human) %>% as.data.frame()
    
  gene_list_mouse <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_mouse)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_mouse) %>% as.data.frame()

  split_human <- sum(gene_list_human$DDE > 0)
  split_mouse <- sum(gene_list_mouse$DDE > 0)

  # --- B. Execute RRHO2 ---
  rrho_obj <- try(RRHO2_initialize(gene_list_mouse, gene_list_human, 
                                   labels = c("Mouse", "Human"), 
                                   boundary = 0.01, log10.ind = TRUE, method = "hyper"), 
                  silent = TRUE)
  
  if(inherits(rrho_obj, "try-error")) next

  # Store the raw object
  raw_objects_list[[iter_name]] <- rrho_obj

  # --- C. Save Plot Data ---
  temp_df <- as.data.frame(rrho_obj$hypermat) %>%
    mutate(Mouse_Rank = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Mouse_Rank, names_to = "Human_Rank", values_to = "LogP") %>%
    mutate(
      Human_Rank = as.numeric(gsub("V", "", Human_Rank)),
      pathogen = curr_pathogen,        
      timepoint = curr_timepoint,
      split_h = split_human,
      split_m = split_mouse
    )
  plot_data_list[[iter_name]] <- temp_df
}

# --- 3. CONSOLIDATE INTO final_results ---
final_results <- list(
  plot_data = bind_rows(plot_data_list),
  objects = raw_objects_list
)


#Extract gene lists
# 1. Define the quadrants we want to extract
quadrants <- c("uu", "dd", "ud", "du")

# 2. Use map_dfr to iterate through each comparison and quadrant
all_extracted_genes <- imap_dfr(final_results$objects, function(obj, condition_name) {
  
  # For each object (comparison), iterate through the 4 quadrants
  map_dfr(quadrants, function(q) {
    
    # Construct the internal names used by RRHO2 (e.g., genelist_uu and gene_list1_uu)
    genelist_slot <- paste0("genelist_", q)
    gene_item_slot <- paste0("gene_list1_", q)
    
    # Extract the list of genes
    genes <- obj[[genelist_slot]][[gene_item_slot]]
    
    # Only create a dataframe if there are genes in that quadrant
    if (!is.null(genes) && length(genes) > 0) {
      data.frame(
        genes = as.character(genes),
        condition = condition_name,
        comparison = genelist_slot,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  })
}) %>% 
  separate(condition, into = c("pathogen", "timepoint_comparison"), sep = "_") %>% 
  separate(comparison, into = c("del", "direction"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(-del) %>% 
  mutate(direction = case_when(direction == "uu" ~ "Up-Up",
                               direction == "ud" ~ "Up-Down",
                               direction == "dd" ~ "Down-Down",
                               direction == "du" ~ "Down-Up",
                               T~direction))


final_results_final = list(
  plotdata = final_results$plot_data, 
  rrho2_obj = final_results$objects, 
     genes = all_extracted_genes)


final_results_final %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_rrho_df.rds"))

```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
library(tidyverse)

  mutate(pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
    pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>%
    #Reorder timepoints
  separate(timepoint, into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human"), remove = F) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7"))) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_mouse) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = fct_inorder(timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    LogP_Final = ifelse(LogP > 50, 50, LogP)

# --- Step 2: Generate the Visualization ---

 scale_fill_gradientn(

        legend.text = element_text(size = 10, 
                                   # hjust = 1, vjust = 1, 
                                   angle = 0),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        legend.box.margin=margin(0,0,-10,0),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "cm"),
        ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1))

# Display and Save
print(rrho_plot)

ggsave(rrho_plot,
```

#### Plot raw ranks
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
# Prepare data
rank_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_log2fc_human) | !is.na(mean_log2fc_mouse),
         !is.na(p_adj_human), !is.na(p_adj_mouse)) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    score_human = -log10(p_adj_human) * sign(mean_log2fc_human),
    score_mouse = -log10(p_adj_mouse) * sign(mean_log2fc_mouse),
    Human_Rank_Val = rank(score_human),
    Mouse_Rank_Val = rank(score_mouse),
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
    pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))

# Calcular os limites por grupo
thresholds <- rank_data %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    # Encontra o maior rank entre os genes com log2fc negativo
    v_line = max(Human_Rank_Val[mean_log2fc_human < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    h_line = max(Mouse_Rank_Val[mean_log2fc_mouse < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Plotar como Heatmap de Densidade (Raster)
rank_density_heatmap = rank_data %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  aes(x = Human_Rank_Val, y = Mouse_Rank_Val) +
  facet_nested_wrap(~pathogen + timepoint_comparison,
                    scales = "free", 
                    nrow = 4,
                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable"), 
                    axes = "all") +
 stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(density / sum(density))), 
                  geom = "raster", 
                  contour = F, 
                  n = 50) +    
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colors = c("white", "#4361ee", "#4DBBD5FF", "#46eec6"),
  na.value = "white", 
  labels = scales::label_percent(), 
  name = "Density (%)",
  guide = guide_colorbar(
    barwidth = 1, 
    barheight = 8, 
    title.position = "top", 
    title.hjust = 0.5,
    ticks.colour = "black",
    frame.colour = "black"
  )
) +
  scale_x_reverse(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0,0)) +
  # Divide by threshold
  geom_vline(data = thresholds, aes(xintercept = v_line), 
             linetype = "solid", color = "white", alpha = 1, linewidth = 2) +
  geom_hline(data = thresholds, aes(yintercept = h_line), 
             linetype = "solid", color = "white", alpha = 1, linewidth = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Rank-Rank Density Heatmap",
    subtitle = "Normalized density per condition",
    x = "Human Gene Rank",
    y = "Mouse Gene Rank"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size =10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8, 
                                   # hjust = 1, vjust = 1, 
                                   angle = 0),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "black", linetype = 1))
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
final_rrho_list = readRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_rrho_df.rds"))

gene_list_df = final_rrho_list$genes %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint_comparison, direction) %>% 
  separate(timepoint_comparison, into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human"), remove = F, sep = "-") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_human = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7"))) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_mouse) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_comparison = fct_inorder(timepoint_comparison),
         direction = fct_relevel(direction, "Up-Up", "Up-Down", "Down-Down", "Down-Up")) %>% 
  #Calculate percentage
  inner_join(
    human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide  %>% 
      select(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
      dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
      rename(n_total = n),
    by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(pct = ((n/n_total)*100) %>% round(0)) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                             pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli", 
                             T~pathogen),
    pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))
```

##### Heatmap
```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
gene_list_df_heatmap = final_rrho_list$genes %>% 
  separate(timepoint_comparison, into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human"), remove = F, sep = "-") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_human = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7"))) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_mouse) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_comparison = fct_inorder(timepoint_comparison),
         direction = fct_relevel(direction, "Up-Up", "Up-Down", "Down-Down", "Down-Up")) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                             pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli", 
                             pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~  "HepB",
                             T~pathogen),
    pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_direction = paste0(direction, " (", timepoint_mouse,")")) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_mouse, direction ) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_direction = fct_inorder(timepoint_direction))


# Clustering
df_to_cluster <- gene_list_df_heatmap %>%
  mutate(val = case_when(
    direction == "Up-Up"     ~  2,
    direction == "Up-Down"   ~  1,
    direction == "Down-Up"   ~ -1,
    direction == "Down-Down" ~ -2,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )) %>%
  select(genes, timepoint_direction, pathogen, val) %>%
  mutate(cond = paste(pathogen, timepoint_direction, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(genes, cond, val) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cond, values_from = val, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("genes")

gene_dist <- dist(as.matrix(df_to_cluster)) 
gene_hclust <- hclust(gene_dist, method = "ward.D2")

# 3. Extrair a ordem dos genes clusterizados
gene_order <- rownames(df_to_cluster)[gene_hclust$order]

# 4. Aplicar a ordem de volta ao dataframe original do ggplot
gene_list_df_heatmap_clustered <- gene_list_df_heatmap %>%
  mutate(genes = factor(genes, levels = gene_order))
```

```{r}
msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         timepoint_direction = paste0(timepoint_mouse, " (", direction, ")")) %>% 
  arrange(fct_rev(direction), timepoint_mouse) %>%
```

### Correlation: Genes, samples

```{r}
#Import
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

all_human_mouse_metadata =
  readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))


#Filter conditions with too many human samples to reduce computation time
set.seed(420)
all_human_mouse_metadata_filtered =
    all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
   filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Trauma", "Influenza", "Burn") & organism == "Human")) %>% 
  
   bind_rows(
     #Sample trauma patients
     all_human_mouse_metadata %>%
      filter(pathogen == "Trauma", treatment == "Trauma", organism == "Human") %>% 
      group_by(timepoint) %>% 
      slice_sample(n = 30, replace = F),
     #Sample Bur patients
     all_human_mouse_metadata %>%
      filter(pathogen == "Burn", treatment == "Burn", organism == "Human") %>% 
      group_by(timepoint) %>% 
      slice_sample(n = 30, replace = F),
     #Sample Fluad patients
     all_human_mouse_metadata %>% 
       filter(participant_id %in% c(all_human_mouse_metadata %>%
                                      filter(pathogen == "Influenza", organism == "Human") %>% 
                                      pull(participant_id) %>% 
                                      unique() %>% 
                                      sample(size = 30, replace = FALSE)))
  )

log2fc_samples = readRDS(here("tables", "all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc.rds")) 

log2fc_samples_annotated = log2fc_samples %>% 
  inner_join(all_human_mouse_metadata_filtered, 
             by = join_by("geo_sample"))
```

By pathogen, all vs all.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Hmisc)
library(here)
library(janitor)

# 1. Define Inputs and Gene Subsets -----------------------------------------
# We create a list to automate the loop over both sets
gene_sets_list <- list(
  "AllGenes" = human_mouse_log2fc_samples,
  "Immune"   = human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% 
                 filter(human_symbol %in% (btm_annotation_genes %>% 
                                          filter(module_category == "immune") %>% 
                                          pull(symbol) %>% unique()))
)


# 2. Main Processing Loop ----------------------------------------------------
# map_dfr iterates through "AllGenes" and "Immune", stacking the results
final_correlations <- map_dfr(names(gene_sets_list), function(set_name) {
  
  message(paste("Processing gene set:", set_name))
  current_data <- gene_sets_list[[set_name]]
  
  # Data Preparation: Long format to Wide Matrix
  genes_samples_long <- current_data %>%
    select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2fc) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(condition = paste0(pathogen, "_", participant_id, "_", timepoint))

  samples_annotation <- genes_samples_long %>%
    select(pathogen, organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>%
    distinct() 

  genes_samples_wide <- genes_samples_long %>%
    select(human_symbol, condition, log2fc) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition", values_from = "log2fc", values_fn = mean) %>%
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

  # 3. Pathogen-Specific Correlation Calculation -----------------------------
  pathogen_list <- unique(samples_annotation$pathogen)
  
  map_dfr(pathogen_list, function(path) {
    
    pathogen_samples <- samples_annotation %>% 
      filter(pathogen == path) %>% 
      pull(condition) 
    
    # Subset matrix and drop NAs
    matrix_subset <- genes_samples_wide %>%
      select(all_of(intersect(pathogen_samples, colnames(.)))) %>%
      # drop_na() %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    if(nrow(matrix_subset) <= 4 | ncol(matrix_subset) < 2) {
      warning(paste("Skipping pathogen:", path, "- only", nrow(matrix_subset), "shared genes found."))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Calculate Spearman Correlation
    cor_obj <- rcorr(matrix_subset, type = "spearman")
    
    # Tidy extraction of Rho and P-values
    r_long <- as.data.frame(cor_obj$r) %>%
      rownames_to_column("condition1") %>%
      pivot_longer(-condition1, names_to = "condition2", values_to = "rho")
    
    p_long <- as.data.frame(cor_obj$P) %>%
      rownames_to_column("condition1") %>%
      pivot_longer(-condition1, names_to = "condition2", values_to = "p_val")
    
    # Join with Metadata and Filter Duplicates
    r_long %>%
      left_join(p_long, by = c("condition1", "condition2")) %>%
      filter(condition1 < condition2) %>%
      left_join(samples_annotation %>% select(condition, organism1 = organism, timepoint1 = timepoint), 
                by = c("condition1" = "condition")) %>%
      left_join(samples_annotation %>% select(condition, organism2 = organism, timepoint2 = timepoint), 
                by = c("condition2" = "condition")) %>%
      mutate(pathogen = path, gene_set = set_name)
  })
})

# 4. Statistical Summary per Comparison and Timepoint -----------------------
correlation_summary <- final_correlations %>% 
  # Keep Human as reference for cross-species comparisons
  filter(!(organism1 == "Mouse" & organism2 == "Human")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism1, " vs. ", organism2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint1, "-", timepoint2)) %>% 
  group_by(gene_set, pathogen, comparison, timepoint1, timepoint2) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_rho = mean(rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rho   = sd(rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    n        = n(),
    se       = sd_rho / sqrt(n),
    ci_low   = mean_rho - (qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se),
    ci_high  = mean_rho + (qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5. Final Filtering (Matched Timepoints and 24h Reference) -----------------
correlation_summary_filtered <- bind_rows(
  # Matched timepoints (e.g., 2h vs 2h)
  correlation_summary %>% 
    filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & comparison == "Human vs. Mouse"),
           timepoint1 == timepoint2),
  
  # 24h reference for acute infections
  correlation_summary %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"),
           comparison == "Human vs. Mouse",
           timepoint1 == "24h")
) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"), 
                                   timepoint2, timepoint1),
         timepoint_label = as.character(timepoint_label),
         timepoint_label = str_replace(timepoint_label,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint_label, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
          pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         gene_set = str_replace(gene_set, "AllGenes", "All genes")) 

correlation_summary_filtered
# Save Output
saveRDS(correlation_summary_filtered, file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gene_sets_correlation_summary.rds")))
```

```{r}
# Prepare long-format table of mean log2FC per sample and process
btm_samples_long = dge_btm_mean_process_sample_long %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, process, participant_id, timepoint, mean_log2fc) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(pathogen, "_", participant_id, "_", timepoint)) %>% 
  drop_na()

# Annotation table
btm_samples_annotation = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(pathogen, organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>% 
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-pathogen, -timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "pearson")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 
  
  mutate(pathogen1 = str_split_i(condition1, "_", 1),
         pathogen2 = str_split_i(condition2, "_", 1)) %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2,
         pathogen1 == pathogen2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2),
         pathogen = pathogen1) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(pathogen, comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, pathogen, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 
  #Filter only matching conditions
  filter(timepoint_condition1 == timepoint_condition2) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition1)
```

```{r}
  distinct()

# Pivot to wide format
btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_long %>% 
  select(-pathogen, -timepoint, -organism, -participant_id) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
              values_from = "mean_log2fc") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("process")

# Compute Correlations and p-values between all conditions
cor_btm_samples_wide_all = btm_samples_wide_all %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  rcorr(type = "pearson")

# Convert correlation matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$r %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "correlation")

# Convert p-value matrix to long format
cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p = cor_btm_samples_wide_all$P %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("condition1") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -condition1,
               names_to = "condition2",
               values_to = "p_value")

# Join correlations, p-values, and sample annotations
correlation_long_all_btm_mouse_human_timepoints_summary = cor_btm_samples_wide_all_r %>% 
  inner_join(cor_btm_samples_wide_all_p, 
             by = join_by("condition1", "condition2")) %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition1")) %>% 
               rename(condition1 = condition_condition1),
             by = "condition1") %>% 
  inner_join(btm_samples_annotation %>% 
               rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_condition2")) %>% 
               rename(condition2 = condition_condition2),
             by = "condition2") %>% 
  
  mutate(pathogen1 = str_split_i(condition1, "_", 1),
         pathogen2 = str_split_i(condition2, "_", 1)) %>% 

  # Remove symmetric duplicates 
  filter(condition1 < condition2,
         pathogen1 == pathogen2) %>% 

  # Keep Human as reference when comparing human and mouse
  filter(!(organism_condition1 == "Mouse" & organism_condition2 == "Human")) %>% 

  # Annotate comparison type and timepoints
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_condition1, " vs. ", organism_condition2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_condition1, "-", timepoint_condition2),
         pathogen = pathogen1) %>% 

  # Compute summary statistics per comparison and timepoint
  group_by(pathogen, comparison, timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = T),
    sd   = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se   = sd / sqrt(n),
    tval = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low  = mean - tval * se,
    ci_high = mean + tval * se
  ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(comparison, pathogen, timepoint_condition1, timepoint_condition2, mean:ci_high) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  arrange(comparison) %>% 
  #Filter only matching conditions
  filter(timepoint_condition1 == timepoint_condition2) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = timepoint_condition1)
```

```{r}
safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y),
  otherwise = NULL
)

dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

dge_btm_process_genes_correlation = dge_btm_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%

  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

filter_1 = dge_btm_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(process, 
          -abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-cor_label,  -p_value)

filter_1 %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint)  %>% 
  arrange() %>% 
  summarise(mean_cor = mean(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            median_cor = median(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            mean_rsq = mean(r_squared, na.rm = T))
```

```{r}
gsea_btm_results_core_joined =
  gsea_btm_results_core %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
         gene = core_enrichment,
         set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
  mutate(human_core = TRUE) %>% 
  full_join(
    gsea_btm_results_core %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
      select(pathogen, process, timepoint,

             set_size_mouse = set_size) %>% 
      mutate(mouse_core = TRUE),
    by = c("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", "gene")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      human_core == TRUE & mouse_core == TRUE ~ "Shared",
      human_core == TRUE & is.na(mouse_core) ~ "Human only",
      mouse_core == TRUE & is.na(human_core) ~ "Mouse only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(pathogen, timepoint, process, status)
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----
#Safe correlation 
safe_cor_test <- function(x, y, method) {
  # Remove NAs and infinite values first
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  # cor.test requires n >= 3 to run without error
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  } else {
    tryCatch({
      ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
      return(list(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value))
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    })
  }
}
# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label, ", ", n
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%

         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,

  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse = cor_value_mouse^2,
    p_label_mouse = case_when(
      p_value_mouse <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse, 2),
      p_label_mouse,", ", n
    )
  )

  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)),
         process = str_wrap(process, width = 15)) %>% 
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_Mouse) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_labels_filter_Mouse_Human, by = join_by(pathogen, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(cor_labels_all_filtered = paste0("All: ", cor_label, ",\nM: ", cor_label_mouse, ",\nM&H: ", cor_label_mouse_human)) %>% 
  #Annotate timepoints
  mutate(timepoint = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Burn", "Trauma") & timepoint %in% c("2h", "2", "Early hours")~"Early hours", 
                               pathogen %in% c("Influenza", "Hepatitis B") ~ paste0("Day ", timepoint),
                               pathogen %in% c("Ecoli", "Saureus") ~ paste0(timepoint, "h"),
                               T ~timepoint),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_comparison = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Escherichia coli", "Staphylococcus aureus"),
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", "24h"), 
                                        paste0(timepoint, "-", timepoint)) %>% 
                                str_replace(., "Early hours-Early hours", "2h-Early"),
         
         #Create facet names
         facet_name = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", cor_labels_all_filtered)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(
         facet_name = fct_inorder(facet_name),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Saureus" ~ "Staphylococcus aureus",
                              pathogen == "Ecoli" ~ "Escherichia coli",
                              T ~pathogen),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))


dge_btm_mean_group_correlation_df %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint, timepoint_comparison)
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
# NES vs NES
# Means vs means
cor_labels_nes <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = nes_Mouse,
         Human = nes_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label
    )
  )

cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = nes_Mouse,
         Human = nes_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse = cor_value_mouse^2,
    p_label_mouse = case_when(
      p_value_mouse <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse, 2),
      p_label_mouse
    )
  )

cor_labels_nes_filter_Mouse_Human <- dge_btm_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_Mouse <= 0.25, p_adjust_Human <= 0.25) %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = nes_Mouse,
         Human = nes_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse_human = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),

  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse_human = cor_value_mouse_human^2,
    p_label_mouse_human = case_when(
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse_human <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse_human = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse_human, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse_human, 2),

    )
```

```{r fig.height=9, fig.width=11, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Plot correlation plot (means)

#Plot all points
  with_blur(

  labs(fill = "Group",
```

```{r fig.height=16, fig.width=16}
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
  select(pathogen, symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint, process) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism,
              values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order)))  %>% 
  #Remove duplicates
  select(-process) %>% 
  distinct()

#Convert to wide
dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide =
  dge_hallmarks_process_genes_matched  %>% 
    ungroup() %>%
    select(symbol, mean_l2fc, adj_p_val, pathogen, organism, timepoint, process, group) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    group_by(pathogen, organism, timepoint) %>% 
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = organism,
      values_from = c(mean_l2fc, adj_p_val)
    ) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, c(immune_order))) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    select(
      symbol,
      pathogen,
      process, 
      timepoint,
      Mouse = mean_l2fc_Mouse,
      Human = mean_l2fc_Human,
      adj_p_val_Mouse,
      adj_p_val_Human,
      group
    ) %>% 
  drop_na(Human, Mouse) 
  


safe_cor_test <- purrr::possibly(
  ~cor.test(.x, .y),
  otherwise = NULL
)

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_wide %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint, process) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(
      x = Human, y = Mouse, method = "pearson"
    )),
    .groups = "drop",
    n_genes = n(),
    group
  ) %>%

  mutate(test_result = purrr::map(
    test_result,
    ~ if (is.null(.x))
      list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
    else
      .x 
    )) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$estimate),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  # Labels
  mutate(
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=",
      round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=",
      round(r_squared, 2),
      ", ",
      p_label
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  distinct()

dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)

filter_1 = dge_hallmarks_process_genes_correlation %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(process, 
          -abs(cor_value)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(-cor_label,  -p_value)

filter_1 %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint)  %>% 
  arrange() %>% 
  summarise(mean_cor = mean(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            median_cor = median(cor_value, na.rm = T),
            mean_rsq = mean(r_squared, na.rm = T))
```

Are the leading edges in mice the same in humans?

```{r}
gsea_hallmarks_results_core = gsea_hallmarks_results_all_matched %>% 
  separate_rows(core_enrichment, sep = "/") 

gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined =
  gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
         gene = core_enrichment,
         set_size_human = set_size) %>% 
  mutate(human_core = TRUE) %>% 
  full_join(
    gsea_hallmarks_results_core %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
      select(pathogen, process, timepoint,
             gene = core_enrichment,
             set_size_mouse = set_size) %>% 
      mutate(mouse_core = TRUE),
    by = c("pathogen", "process", "timepoint", "gene")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      human_core == TRUE & mouse_core == TRUE ~ "Shared",
      human_core == TRUE & is.na(mouse_core) ~ "Human only",
      mouse_core == TRUE & is.na(human_core) ~ "Mouse only",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  arrange(pathogen, timepoint, process, status)

gsea_hallmarks_results_core_joined %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen, timepoint)
```

```{r}
      ungroup() %>% 
      filter(str_detect(process, process_selected)) %>% 
      select(process, pathogen, timepoint, nes_Mouse, nes_Human),

    nes_Mouse = round(nes_Mouse, 2),

  mutate(status = if_else(is.na(status), "Not core", status)) %>%

             by = join_by("pathogen", "process", "timepoint")) %>%

  arrange(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(facet_label = fct_inorder(facet_label),
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
#Calculate correlation -----
#Safe correlation 
safe_cor_test <- function(x, y, method) {
  # Remove NAs and infinite values first
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]
  
  # cor.test requires n >= 3 to run without error
  if (length(x) < 3 || sd(x) == 0 || sd(y) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  } else {
    tryCatch({
      ct <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
      return(list(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), p.value = ct$p.value))
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
    })
  }
}
# Means vs means
cor_labels <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  select(pathogen, process, timepoint, group,
         Mouse = mean_log2fc_Mouse,
         Human = mean_log2fc_Human) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method =  "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    filter = "all",
    r_squared = cor_value^2,
    p_label = case_when(
      p_value <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared, 2),
      p_label
    )
  )

cor_labels_filter_Mouse <- dge_hallmarks_gsea_mean_wide %>%
  filter(p_adjust_mean_Mouse <= 0.25) %>%

  group_by(pathogen, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    test_result = list(safe_cor_test(Human, Mouse, method = "pearson")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cor_value_mouse = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "estimate"),
    p_value_mouse   = purrr::map_dbl(test_result, "p.value")
  ) %>%
  select(-test_result) %>%
  mutate(
    r_squared_mouse = cor_value_mouse^2,
    p_label_mouse = case_when(
      p_value_mouse <= 0.01 ~ "***",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.05 ~ "**",
      p_value_mouse <= 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ "ns"
    ),
    cor_label_mouse = paste0(
      "r=", round(cor_value_mouse, 2),
      ", R²=", round(r_squared_mouse, 2),

    )
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
# Enrichment analysis -------
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"
#Hallmarks
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_raw <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") 
#Clean
msigdbr_df = msigdbr_raw %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))

#Discretize by quartile
df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse = zscore_genes %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<Q25",
    quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">Q75",
    TRUE ~ quartile_label)) %>% 
    mutate(condition = paste0(comparison, "", quartiles_grouped, " (", timepoint_day,")")) %>% 
  filter(quartiles_grouped != "Q50") %>% 
  select(genes = human_symbol,
         condition)

#Run ORA Hallmarks
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse,
  term2gene_df = msigdbr_df) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "(?<=\\(Day )\\d+")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = case_when(str_detect(condition, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))
#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))

#Print
ora_all_diff_hallmark
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
#Plot

  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_p_adjust, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           quantile = str_extract(condition, "Q\\d{2,3}"),
        condition = paste(quantile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = str_to_upper(description), fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", 
            size = 0.2, na.rm = F, stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "white",     
        high = "#4DBBD5FF",   
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(0, 4),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "-Log(FDR)") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.2, 'cm'),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust=0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 1, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
     labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, MSigDB Hallmarks") +
  facet_nested(~ paste("Day", timepoint) + fct_rev(comparison), scales = "free", space = "free")
```
